fact: The Federal Government, through the Ministry of Police Affairs, formally received the WAPIS platform and infrastructure from the European Union and INTERPOL at a handover in Abuja reported on 8 April 2025; the Minister, who chairs the WAPIS National Committee, said the MoU with INTERPOL dated from 16 April 2019, that the Nigeria Police Force is the coordinating agency among eight participating agencies, and that the Ministry and the Force had submitted a budget proposal to the President to sustain the system.
title: FG RECEIVES WAPIS PLATFORM AND INFRASTRUCTURE FROM EUROPEAN UNION
